definitions.explanation: A tropical bird known for its colorful plumage and ability to mimic human speech.

examples.japanese: {鸚鵡|おうむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧「⟦こんにちは→こんにちは：02839_konnichiha⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}いました→言う：00515_iu⟧。
{鸚鵡|おうむ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人間|にんげん}→人間：03523_ningen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{真似|まね}→真似：03736_mane⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{色|いろ}とりどり→色とりどり：10404_irotoridori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{鸚鵡|おうむ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{止|と}まって→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Colorful parrots are perched on the tree.

notes:
{鸚鵡|おうむ} is usually written in katakana as オウム in modern usage.

The kanji is rarely used as it's complex.

Common expressions:
- {鸚鵡|おうむ}⟦{返|がえ}し→返し：24802_kaeshi⟧ (parroting, repeating what someone said without understanding)

Note: The same word is used for cockatoos. ⟦インコ→インコ：18655_inko⟧ refers to smaller parakeets/parrots.

The {鸚鵡|おうむ}⟦{貝|がい}→貝：02145_kai⟧ (nautilus) is named for its shell pattern resembling a parrot's beak.
